name.zh: 珠雫复活一辉与史黛菈焚尽欧尔·格尔
name.en: Shizuku revives Ikki and Stella burns Or-Gaule

periods.type: miraculous healing / final duel / war conclusion
periods.summary: Stella's grief over Ikki's death triggers Ultra Awakening, but she refuses to regret meeting him and instead channels anger at his broken promise into controlled resolve. Shizuku arrives and reveals she can revive Ikki, using Water World to break his remains into cells and reconstruct his body; she identifies that Or-Gaule's Danse Macabre can manipulate flesh and debris but not ash. Stella rallies the soldiers and civilians, while Nene promises to protect everyone from one full-power attack. Dandelion organizes soldiers into layered shield lines, Sirius protects Shizuku and Ikki's remains, and Stella engages Or-Gaule in her dragonized form. Or-Gaule prepares La Grand Guignol, a massacre-level thread attack, but delayed Kuruizakura cuts that Ikki secretly planted during his one-minute duel tear open across his body and disrupt the technique. Stella pierces him with Laevateinn and unleashes Calusaritio Salamander at point blank, burning him down to ash. She rejects his claim that nobody helped him by naming Alice's love and says he is alone because he never truly loved anyone. The war finally ends, and Stella keeps a handful of his ash so he can be buried with Alice.
periods.cause: Ikki's sacrifice buys Stella time and plants the hidden cuts, while Shizuku's arrival gives Stella reason to fight without despairing over Ikki's death.
periods.outcome: Or-Gaule is permanently destroyed; Ikki's reconstruction begins; Vermillion and Quedland are saved with no civilian massacre.
casualties: or-gaule permanently killed and reduced to ash
ikki-kurogane remains clinically dead until Shizuku's reconstruction completes
many soldiers wounded but protected from final blast
periods.significance: Ends the Vermillion-Quedland war, establishes Shizuku's death-defying Water World and A-rank worthiness, and proves Stella can control Ultra Awakening through love rather than despair.
